title: Rule-based payment fraud scoring
statement: Score each payment against VELOCITY (>5 in 300 s), AMOUNT_ZSCORE (>3.0σ, last 200) and GEO_MISMATCH and emit alerts to bronze.fraud_alerts.

title: Fraud alert latency
statement: Fraud alerts surface within one fraud window (300 s); RFC goal says sub-minute.

title: EU data residency for all storage and processing
statement: All storage and processing pinned to EU regions; no code path transfers data outside the EU; DR must stay EU-only.

evidence.excerpt: All storage and processing is pinned to EU regions

title: Right to erasure cascade (Art. 17)
statement: An erasure request adds the customer to the suppression registry, masks Bronze PII, deletes Silver/Gold/fraud-alert rows and re-snapshots the lake.

evidence.excerpt: Suppression registry | Bronze | Silver | Gold | Fraud alerts | Lake export

title: Erasure SLA 60 seconds (application target)
statement: The cascade completes within EUROSTREAM_ERASURE_SLA_SECONDS (60); a breach counter increments otherwise. Not the statutory period.

title: Auditable erasure trail
statement: Each erasure writes an audit record (JSONL + governance.erasure_audit_log) with a confirmation hash.

title: Marketing consent propagates to Gold
statement: marketing_consent is carried to Gold; non-consenting customers must not flow into marketing-facing aggregates. The serving filter is outside the repo.

evidence.excerpt: no non-consenting customer flows into marketing-facing aggregates

conflicts.note: 'this repository does not include a downstream marketing-serving filter'

title: Pseudonymize PII at the Silver boundary
statement: Silver stores salted SHA-256 of email and IBAN; the salt must be secret in production.

evidence.excerpt: concatenates the salt, a colon, and the source value

title: Clear PII only in internal Bronze; Bronze never exported
statement: Bronze keeps clear-text email, IBAN and IP by design for internal use; public exports exclude Bronze.

evidence.excerpt: PII is present in clear text — this is intentional

title: Event schema contracts enforced in CI
statement: Event model schemas are snapshotted to governance/contracts.json; CI fails on breaking drift.

evidence.excerpt: A committed contracts.json snapshot plus a drift check in CI

title: Quality gates abort the DAG
statement: Six checks (uniqueness ×2, PII-not-clear ×2, consent gating, referential integrity) run after transform; any failure aborts the DAG.

evidence.excerpt: runs six checks after the medallion transformation

title: Fail on unregistered PII columns
statement: A new PII-looking column not in governance/pii_manifest.json fails the pipeline (60% majority vote, IBAN mod-97).

evidence.excerpt: fails if a new PII-like column appears that is not registered

title: Event bus Kafka (Aiven) / SQLite local
statement: Topics orders, clicks, payments, fraud_alerts, erasure_requests; backend chosen by EUROSTREAM_EVENT_BUS_BACKEND; MSK on AWS as deployment target.

evidence.excerpt: Define a Producer/Consumer interface. Two implementations

title: Public Parquet lake on Hugging Face
statement: Silver/Gold Parquet is uploaded to a public Hugging Face dataset on a schedule; erasure re-exports the local lake only.

conflicts.note: 'No code path transfers data outside the EU'

title: Portfolio artefact, not production
statement: The RFC states the platform is a portfolio artefact runnable on a laptop with no cloud spend; BI tooling, Kubernetes and ML fraud are non-goals.

evidence.excerpt: must be demonstrated as a portfolio artifact
